variants.about_this_item:
• can be slung around the body or used with hand loop
  • shock absorber softens sudden pulls by the dog
  • fully adjustable fit
  • padded loop with snap hook
  • webbing tape

Staying Active Together Our jogging lead is a true all-rounder: The adjustable loop at the end of the lead can be used as a hand strap, shoulder strap, or waist strap. It is entirely up to you. You can attach a dog tag or a reflector to the small eyelet next to the clasp for better visibility, for example, so you’re both clearly visible in all light conditions. If your dog pulls suddenly on the lead, this is cushioned by built-in shock absorbers. You can easily adjust how close your dog runs to you while jogging using the lead’s stepless length adjustment. Do you have your running gear and the TRIXIE dog jogging lead with you? Then nothing stands in the way of your athletic experience!
